correctness.1: Partly correct or materially overstated; human judgment required
correctness.2: Correct and appropriately qualified; mock oracle checks labels only

evidence.0: Unknown evidence ID or unsupported basis
evidence.1: Required evidence missing or incomplete attribution
evidence.2: Required supplied evidence cited; semantic attribution still needs review

review.method: Mechanical label checks are diagnostic only. Semantic scores require bound reviewer records and adjudication.
review.human_requirement: Two independent blinded human reviewers for ambiguous live cases, with adjudication. No human review has been completed.
review.severity: Invented fact/source IDs are flagged automatically; serious fabrication and other unsupported assertions require semantic review.

uncertainty: Full analysis must cluster by case, preserving branches and repeats. Four cases do not support reliable effect-size claims.
mock_policy: Never eligible for performance, promotion, publication, or release claims, regardless of scores.
